domain: 航班行程研究与跨网站订票
scope: 以受访者使用 Skyscanner 研究现金票为中心，同时保留跨聚合器、供应商、航司、积分票和贵宾室的必要边界。
methodology: 逐段完整阅读原文后人工式语义判断；条目由评审模型编写，程序仅校验引用和序列化，不以关键词抽取代替理解。未读取技能、论文目标、tests、生成结果或既有评估。条目不是最终目标模型，不规定唯一层次或粒度。

intents.intent: 找到价格合适且满足行程安排的航班
intents.subject: 受访旅客（主要本人，也替亲友）
intents.conditions: 计划旅行并研究现金票时
intents.exceptions: 有时为体验航班接受更贵、更长路线

evidence.quote: my primary focus is to like get a really good deal
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: Best results for me is a combination of the logistics in terms of the itinerary that I want the price and the flexibility. All 3 aspects combined. mostly focusing on the 1st 2.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 尽量提前订票以获得较好价格
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 理想订票时机
intents.exceptions: 最近国内行程常仅提前一两周；紧急旅行可当天订

evidence.quote: Mostly I try to aim for at least one to 1.5 months out, just to get like a better price at a better deal.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: there are rare occasions where I just have to book a flight.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 在不同时间反复比价并探索多个网站的最佳优惠
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 有时间研究时
intents.exceptions: 可能跨几天或几周，没有固定频率；最后一分钟可很快完成

evidence.quote: I check like dozens of different websites to just make sure I'm having the best deal possible.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: It is very situationally dependent.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 灵活组合区域、国家、邻近机场及日期，缩小到可行行程
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 研究起讫地点时
intents.exceptions: 不是始终限制本地机场或某个固定城市对

evidence.quote: I generally do country to country pairs
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: I would rather search with a series of different airports.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 使航班时刻与后续交通、住宿、会面安排和休息相匹配
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 比较可行行程时
intents.exceptions: 可接受红眼，但更愿意睡好；价格太高可接受等车风险

evidence.quote: I don't end up having to stay in a city
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: Is it matching up with the schedules of the person who, if I'm going to meet somebody, and that's it. Is it matching up with their schedules.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: I don't mind taking a red eye, but I would rather get my night's sleep.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 比较供应商价格、评价、折扣、优惠券和升级，确定最终总价与订票渠道
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 已圈定理想航班后
intents.exceptions: 可跨聚合器或直接向供应商、航司订票，渠道不固定

evidence.quote: I look at the price. I take a look at the rating, and I often visit multiple providers from this page.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: whichever is giving me a better deal with any sort of coupons and discounts that I can apply to it.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 确认每段航班、转机、当地日期时间、终站等物流细节适合自己
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 选择行程、跳转供应商前
intents.exceptions: 展示所有功能本身不等于使用所有过滤器

evidence.quote: I make sure all the flight details like I said. All the connections and all the times are right for me, and they work for my schedule.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: I'll just make sure all the terminal, all the logistics. Information is correct.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 按国际或国内场景平衡价格和总旅程时长
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 浏览排序结果时
intents.exceptions: 国际主要看 best 避免廉价结果中四五六十小时行程；国内多数看 cheapest；不是一概选最快

evidence.quote: when I'm booking domestic, it's mostly going through the cheapest tab.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: the best is like a more medium section, like something that balances between price and the time taken.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 必要时用出到达时窗及最长旅行时长过滤不合适航班
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 接续其他交通或有时长上限时
intents.exceptions: 通常很少使用过滤器，不要求所有过滤器均为个人目标

evidence.quote: The filters. I don't use it very often unless I'm connecting onto something.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: If I also have a hard limit on the number of hours I want to spend in the sky.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 行程不合适时重查替代路线，兼顾紧迫性和预算
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 所选航班细节不符合期望时
intents.exceptions: 紧急且无好替代则仍订；学生预算可能优先于时间舒适度

evidence.quote: I try to just rerun through all of my options. Make sure I'm not missing something.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: If the price. Differential was way too high. Then I just couldn't afford to like, you know. Spend that much extra
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 在陌生市场判断当前价格是否合理
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 不熟悉地区票价时
intents.exceptions: 熟悉后不再需要该功能；并未要求持续预测最低价

evidence.quote: I can use Google flights for it because it tells me if the price is above, below, or lower than the Median.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: it would help out for the times when I'm not familiar with the specific market.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 保留足够转机缓冲以应对延误与机场连接
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 有中转且无签证障碍时
intents.exceptions: 不普遍限制中转次数；一般至少最短转机时间的1.5倍或2倍

evidence.quote: Unless I have visa issues, I generally don't care very much about it
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: I I generally tend to at least go for 1.5 x or 2 x of that for a stopover.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 核查转机贵宾室是否开放以及自己能否使用
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 考虑停留机场、时刻和信用卡/通行证权益时
intents.exceptions: 取决于卡、终站、访问政策、剩余额度及施工；不是保证任一机场可用

evidence.quote: will the lounge at that airport be open at that point of time?
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: What's their access policy? What's their timings? Is the renovation going on?
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 希望最新个人权益信息可与行程研究整合
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 有网站能可靠保存并更新卡片权益时
intents.exceptions: 现有服务更新不好，当前更信任发卡方/通行证官方来源

evidence.quote: there would be a website that keeps everything updated about what I have and what that would grant me access to. and that would be integrated with skyscanner. That would be wonderful.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: I prefer going to the source of the truth for the lounge access
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 研究现金票时尽量匿名并减少数据分享
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 一般浏览 Skyscanner 或 Google Flights 时
intents.exceptions: 积分票必须登录；极特殊被迫场景可能登录；单纯承诺不售数据不足以取得信任

evidence.quote: I avoid logging in, and I try to keep myself as anonymized as possible.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: It would be a very specific scenario that I really need to do this.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 需要积分票时登录持有积分的航空公司查询并兑换
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 决定用里程或积分而非现金时
intents.exceptions: 明确不使用 Skyscanner 查询积分票；知道但不亲用第三方积分聚合器

evidence.quote: if I have to make a points or an award booking, I'd log on to the airline that I have a loyalty account with where I have my points.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 特殊刚需且价格骤升时接收多个路线的降价提醒
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 必须出行而现价过高时
intents.modality: 过去一次的条件性目标
intents.exceptions: 既有 Google 登录让设置更方便；不是要求新建 Skyscanner 提醒功能，该功能已被受访者确认存在

evidence.quote: I needed a reminder on a few different routes, just to make sure that if any one of them goes down in price.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: It does have the same functionality.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 更快、更准确、同时研究大量路线日期舱位组合
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 跨城市、日期、舱位及现金/积分方案搜索时
intents.exceptions: 未给固定速度阈值或必须节省百分比；长期少量节时也有价值

evidence.quote: You want to do hundreds of searches at the same time
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: more accurately research for things while spending less time at it.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: even if it's saving me just a couple of minutes, because they add up.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 在一处取得研究所需信息，减少多站切换
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 确定理想订票方案时
intents.modality: 由障碍直接支持的改进意图
intents.exceptions: 不能据此把所有外部业务都声明为 Skyscanner 现有职责

evidence.quote: I don't get to have all of my information at one pace I end up having to visit at least 10 to 12 different sites
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 凭熟悉的稳定界面降低搜索操作负担
intents.subject: 旅客
intents.conditions: 大量重复搜索时
intents.exceptions: 别的平台多半只多花30秒到1分钟；达到更快研究可愿意投入学习

evidence.quote: the website doesn't change very often the interface remains the same.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: being familiar with the user interface and being able to quickly key in things and search for things just saves you time.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

intents.intent: 完成行程和渠道决策后提供旅客资料并付款取得机票
intents.subject: 旅客/代订者
intents.conditions: 最终订票阶段
intents.exceptions: Skyscanner 只链接供应商行程页，不自行订票；可能需要护照资料和声明

evidence.quote: enter in all my details and pay for the booking through my card.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

evidence.quote: It links you to the others who can do the bookings.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

background_candidates.item: 航空爱好、最长航班和停留城市的故事
background_candidates.reason: 说明行程偏好，不能把示例 Singapore–Newark 或无限中转写为每次任务的固定目标。

evidence.quote: I also get the ability to filter by flight emissions

evidence.quote: I rarely make much differentiation over here in terms of the filters.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

background_candidates.reason: 演示例子，无证据表明是拟订行程。

evidence.quote: I selected one of the flight paths randomly.
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

background_candidates.item: 其他聚合器矩阵数量与11,760组合示例
background_candidates.reason: 说明组合研究复杂性，不宜误作硬性系统容量或精确需求数量。

evidence.quote: 11,760 different combinations of flights
evidence.speaker: Stakeholder

unresolved: 行程好坏明确依情境，没有全局固定权重或价格阈值。
“never log in”有被迫或特殊需求例外，不能写成绝对禁止登录。
贵宾室整合是有条件愿望；受访者强调现有第三方更新不可靠。
积分查询为并行旅程，受访者明确不在 Skyscanner 完成。
价格跟踪与隐私判断是受访者信念，不能当成平台事实。
